$docs: Committed template — NO real keys. Copy to secrets.develop.json (local dev) or use secrets.production.example.json as a guide for production env vars / secrets.production.json mount.
$setup: Copy-Item secrets.example.json secrets.develop.json  →  fill values  →  dotnet run --project backend/src/Vni.Ielts.Api

Jwt.$SigningKey: Optional in dev (auto-generated if empty). Required in production — min 32 chars. Env: Jwt__SigningKey

Ai.$AllowCrossBorderTransfer: true only after PDPL/B-2 decision. Env: Ai__AllowCrossBorderTransfer

OpenAi.$BaseUrl: Empty = official OpenAI. Reseller (vietapi) = synthetic smoke only. Env: Ai__OpenAi__BaseUrl
OpenAi.$SyntheticDataOnly: true blocks learner essays on third-party BaseUrl. Env: Ai__OpenAi__SyntheticDataOnly

Google.$ClientId: Google Cloud OAuth WEB client. Env: Sso__Google__ClientId

Email.$Host: Empty = no SMTP (dev OK). Env: Email__Host

ObjectStorage.$ServiceUrl: MinIO local or R2/S3 endpoint. Env: ObjectStorage__ServiceUrl
ObjectStorage.$layout: Default: one bucket per retention class, prefixes empty. Alternative (ADR-0016, owner decision 2026-09-04): one bucket for all three with a distinct folder each — set the three *Prefix keys (e.g. examassets/, dictation/, speakingrecord/); the startup gate refuses shared buckets whose prefixes overlap, and the shared bucket must not be versioned.
